Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. M.C. Pant, Advocate for the 
petitioner in WPMS No. 1221 of 2025.
Mr. M.S. Bisht, Brief Holder for the 
State.
Mr. D.C.S. Rawat, Advocate for the 
caveator.
Mr. R.K. Chauhan, Advocate for the 
respondents/Bank.
There is dispute with regard to the 
Manager of Committee of Management 
Children Modern Academy, Dehradun.
Now supplementary affidavit and 
supplementary counter affidavit have also 
been filed by the petitioner and the 
respondent no.3 respectively.
On behalf of the petitioner, it is being 
argued that, in fact, the petitioner was 
elected Manager by the Managing 
Committee in its meeting held on 
14.08.2010, which was subsequently 
registered also and his name is so 
registered in the State records.
Let State file a short affidavit 
revealing all the details of this academy 
post 14.08.2010 as to who was the 
Manager, when this society was registered 
and when it was renewed up till date?
Let such affidavit be filed within two 
weeks.
List on 08.07.2025.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 19.06.2025
Jitendra
